name: Gamma-Ray Burst Scintillator
description: Scintillation crystal detector sensitive to relativistic transient events and black hole mergers.

name: Grazing-Incidence X-Ray Spectrometer
description: Nested shell optics measuring high-energy accretion discs and stellar black hole flares.

name: Far-Ultraviolet Stellar Imager
description: Monolithic mirror telescope capturing hot young massive stars and ionised nebulae.

name: High-Resolution Planetary Camera
description: Visible light multiband sensor for exoplanet transit photometery and stellar surveys.

name: Cryogenic Infrared Sounder
description: Actively cooled IR sensor piercing interstellar dust to detect primordial galaxies and protostars.

name: Cosmic Microwave Radiometer
description: Heterodyne receiver observing cosmic microwave background anisotropy and early cosmic dawn.
